## About
Carolina Auto Truck and Coach Service handles commercial fleet repair and private vehicle needs across the greater Charlotte area. Our customers range from corporations with whole fleets to a person who just needs their own car looked after.
Our trained and experienced technicians work with current diagnostic and accessibility equipment, so we can take on buses, box trucks, rigs and motorhomes as well as pickups. Reviewers mention Jay, Darlene and Lynn by name.
We've built our reputation by putting our customers first, and we're rated 4.7 from 36 Google reviews.

## Services
- Any Vehicle Digital All Wheel Alignments: Digital alignments for cars, trucks and larger vehicles.
- D.O.T. & NC Inspections: Inspections for commercial and private vehicles.
- Generator Repair & Maintenance: Repair and upkeep for the generator on your coach or work vehicle.
- Brake Services (Hydraulic or Air): Hydraulic or air brake work.
- Transmissions (Replacement or Repair): We repair or replace transmissions.
- Drive Line & In House Differential Repairs: Drive line and differential repairs done in our own shop.
- Engine Replacements: One reviewer had the engine replaced in his Dodge Ram and said it runs beautifully.
- Preventive Maintenance (Diesel or Gas): Regular maintenance to keep diesel and gas vehicles working.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on recreational vehicles and motorhomes?
A: Yes. Along with commercial fleets and personal vehicles, we service recreational vehicles.

Q: Do you work on diesel as well as gas?
A: Yes. Tune ups, preventive maintenance and diagnostics cover both gas and diesel engines.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I use the contact form?
A: One of our staff members will be in touch within 48 hours.
